answer: Grade by commit-then-reveal so colluders cannot copy each other. Each grader first submits only a HASH of its score; scores stay sealed like seeds under willow bark until all commits are in, then all reveal at once. A grader trying to match the ring's verdict cannot — it committed blind, before any score was visible in the meadow of the panel. Non-revealers and hash-mismatches are slashed, so withholding is no escape. This breaks the coordination channel a grading cartel needs; honest judgment is unaffected and blooms like a rotating orchard, each grader scoring on merit alone.
